common.tagline: Grade the notebook, not the screen.

setup.title: Tinta isn't configured yet
setup.body: The app can't reach its database because some environment variables are missing.
setup.steps: Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill in NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, then restart the server. See README → Setup.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Grade your students' paper work with feedback right on the page. You review and approve everything.
login.linkSent: Check your inbox: we sent you a sign-in link. You can close this tab.
login.error: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again in a moment.
login.callbackError: That link expired or was already used. Request a new one.
login.privacyNote: Your students' data is private and is never used to train AI models.
